title: consolidate-lint-and-test-steps-into-composite-action-and-prune-ci-matrix
author: Priya Nair
body:
Motivation: Our monorepo CI has accumulated duplicated lint/test steps and a growing GitHub Actions matrix that increases queue times and flakey windows. This PR introduces a composite action that consolidates linting, unit tests, and type checks into a single reusable step, prunes unnecessary matrix axes for non-runtime packages, and updates a small set of GitHub Action dependency pins to the latest stable versions. Goals: 1) reduce workflow code duplication (move repeated steps into .github/actions/composite/lint-test), 2) shorten average runner time for non-Critical CI by ~20-30%, 3) make future CI changes atomic via the composite action, and 4) unblock release automation refactors by providing a single action consumers can adopt.

Summary of changes: - Added a new composite action at .github/actions/composite/lint-test/action.yml. The action runs ESLint, mypy, pytest (selected packages), and a light-weight JS build verification. It exposes inputs for 'scope' and 'fast-fail' and returns annotations for failures so GH UI surfacing is preserved. - Replaced duplicated job steps in workflows: .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/ci-python.yml, and .github/workflows/verify-release.yml to call the composite action. - Pruned the test matrix for several infra packages: removed node-version from the matrix for packages that are node-agnostic and collapsed redundant environment combinations. - Bumped actions/checkout v2 -> v4, actions/setup-node v2 -> v4 (minor config changes handled), and actions/cache pin for improved cache key stability. - Small repo hygiene: removed a legacy script runner wrapper scripts/ci/run-tests.sh in favor of the action input. - Updated README CI section with adoption notes and a migration checklist.

Commits (high-level): - 0a3c9f4 chore(ci): add composite lint-test action - 7b2d6a1 chore(ci): wire composite action into main CI workflow - 9f44a12 chore(ci): prune matrix for infra packages to reduce runs - a1d7b8e deps: bump actions/checkout/setup-node/actions-cache pins - d4e2f05 docs: update CI docs and migration notes - 3c0e9b2 refactor: remove legacy ci wrapper script

Changed files (high-level list): - .github/actions/composite/lint-test/action.yml - .github/actions/composite/lint-test/Dockerfile (lightweight node/python image) - .github/workflows/ci.yml - .github/workflows/ci-python.yml - .github/workflows/verify-release.yml - scripts/ci/run-tests.sh (deleted) - docs/ci.md - package.json (devDeps alignment for lint/test) - .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ci-bug.md (updated guidance)

Testing: Local smoke runs via act and multiple sample workflow runs on a dedicated test branch. Measured wall-time on an average CI matrix entry before/after: main repo lint+tests job reduced from ~12m to ~8.5m (28% improvement) for infra packages where matrix was pruned. Verified sarif annotations still appear in PR checks for ESLint and mypy. Ran release verification workflow against a staging tag: composite action worked as a drop-in replacement and respected the 'fast-fail' input to stop early on critical failures.

CI timeline / flakes: Initial workflow run on 2026-02-18 failed due to actions/checkout v4 needing permission change for token access (caught by Samir). Follow-up commit adjusted permissions and re-ran; subsequent runs passed. Minor transient network flake observed in actions/cache on 2026-02-20, reran successfully.

Review conversation (condensed): - Ethan: "Nice consolidation — can we keep the npm cache separation for yarn v3?" Author: "Yes, added an optional cache-key input and kept separate paths when scope includes node-packages." - Marta: "Please add a short migration note for any external consumers of the old script." Author: "Added docs and a small migration checklist in docs/ci.md." - Samir: Requested that the matrix pruning be opt-in per-package. Author: "Made pruning opt-in by adding ci-matrix: minimal flag in package metadata; default unchanged for runtime packages." Approvals: Ethan and Marta approved after requested changes were addressed. Samir approved after the pruning opt-in was implemented.

Merge: Squash and merge on 2026-02-24. Post-merge actions: opened a short follow-up ticket (ENG-3191) to roll the composite action into the dedicated CI for Redwood Dedicated and Redwood Private (these targets need different caching semantics). Also added a small follow-up PR planned to add telemetry for composite action runtime.

Release notes: "chore(ci): add reusable composite lint/test action and reduce redundant matrix runs; bumps actions pins. Improves CI runtime and reduces duplication. No functional changes to runtime code."

Notes for adopters: - To adopt the composite action, replace repetitive steps with: uses: ./github/actions/composite/lint-test with inputs.scope and inputs.fast-fail as needed. - If you rely on legacy scripts, check scripts/ci/run-tests.sh for behavior and follow migration checklist in docs/ci.md. - If you are in a runtime package, set ci-matrix: minimal=false in package metadata to retain prior matrix coverage.
